meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 只读抓取仓库里所有 open 的 issue 和 PR,每个条目开一个后台 quick 任务分析,把带 GitHub permalink 证据的报告写到 /tmp/{日期时间}/ 目录。它不对 GitHub 做任何写操作。
howto.when: 当你说「triage」「triage issues」「triage PRs」等词,或要求对某个仓库做 GitHub triage 时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 这个仓库所有 open 的 issue
say.note: 每个 issue 生成一份报告文件

say.text: triage 所有 open PR,报告写到 /tmp
say.note: 逐个后台分析,不改动仓库

say.text: 用 github triage 分析 #123 这个 issue
say.note: 只读分析,结论附 permalink 证据

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude reads all open GitHub issues and PRs, spawns one background quick task per item, and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. It never comments, merges, closes or labels - reports only.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "triage", "triage issues", "triage PRs" or "github triage", or ask for a GitHub triage of a repo.

say_en.text: Triage all open issues in this repo
Triage all open PRs and write reports to /tmp

say_en.note: Read-only; every claim backed by a permalink
